newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Japan's Itochu stepping up Israel presence.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Itochu stepping up Israel presence.

text.p: Japanese trading company Itochu has begun seeking Israeli companies as partners to develop new products and markets in Israel and third countries, Israel's Manufacturers Association said on Monday.

Itochu will work with the association to identify Israeli companies that it can help in recruiting strategic investors, marketing and developing new products, said Moshe Nahum, head of the association's foreign trade division.
Itochu also wants to jointly develop with Israeli companies new products for markets in the former Soviet Union and the Middle East, including the Palestinian self-ruled areas, Nahum sid.

The newest venture marks a deepening of Itochu's presence in Israel, which began quietly two years ago. Until now, the company, which has annual turnover of about $17 billion, restricted its interest to Israel's high-tech sector. Now it hopes to form relationships in new industries, Nahum said.
Nahum said he had been meeting Itochu executives from around the Middle East.
